name: When is the best time during a home renovation to schedule interior painting coordination?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time during a home renovation to schedule interior painting coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to schedule interior painting is typically after major construction, plumbing, and electrical rough-ins are complete, but before final flooring and fixtures are installed. This allows for protection of new elements and ensures surfaces are ready. Effective coordination from Frasheski Construction involves planning this phase early in the renovation to align with other trade schedules, preventing bottlenecks. Having surfaces prepared and a clear color scheme decided beforehand ensures a smooth transition to the painting stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule interior painting after major rough-ins but before final flooring and fixtures. Early planning ensures smooth integration with other renovation stages.
